title: Station job result answer
description: The hub's 200 answer to POST /api/station/jobs/<id> (Hub.handle, sizeup/cloud/hub.py): the result reached the caller that was waiting. The station reads only the status. 404 `no such job (it timed out)`: the hub's caller gave up before the result came, or the result was delivered before (the work was done all the same, J1); 400 `a JSON object` for a body that is JSON but no object, `bad request: ...` for one that is not JSON; 413 `too large` over 16 MiB. Those bodies are station-error objects (`error` alone, no `reason`). The station gives up on any 4xx.
